entries.text_jp: アガスティアの木:若者よ…

entries.translation_en: Do you wish to record with me?
What the hell is going on?!
So this time has finally come...

entries.text_jp: かわいそうな冴子さん
転んで腹でも扞ったのかい?
entries.translation_en: Did you fall and hit your head or something?

entries.text_jp: ｜私は仮面をつけても大夫夬』
entries.translation_en: "I will be fine even if I put on the mask",

entries.text_jp: 自分が話題の宇沚になるためなら他人の事なんて考えもしない
entries.translation_en: If it meant being the center of attention, she never gave a thought to anyone else.

entries.text_jp: そんなつまんない芝君
entries.translation_en: Putting on such a pathetic act...

entries.text_jp: 周りをよくご覽なさいな
entries.translation_en: Take a good look around you.

entries.text_jp: フフフフ…これが定談に思えて?
entries.translation_en: Fufufu... Does this look like a joke to you?

entries.text_jp: すべてが永遠の静寂に把かれた
手方運も永遠の氷をまとって
entries.translation_en: You too shall be draped in eternal ice,

entries.text_jp: いくら旡生だからって…
entries.translation_en: Even if you are a teacher...

entries.text_jp: かわいいお嫂さんだこと
こっちへいらっしゃい

entries.translation_en: I will grant you eternal beauty.

entries.text_jp: 仮面が旡生を帚っ取ったんだ!!

entries.translation_en: What do you think you're doing?!

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生に変なマネしたら
entries.translation_en: If you lay a finger on Saeko-sensei,

entries.text_jp: アタシが承知しないよ!!
entries.translation_en: you'll have to answer to me!!

entries.text_jp: 科卯を解いてしまったのは
entries.translation_en: Who was it that broke the seal,

entries.text_jp: 勝手に仮面をかぶったのは?
entries.translation_en: and put on the mask of her own free will?

entries.text_jp: 人を｜化け物』と唾ぶのは

entries.translation_en: shall we have you call me

entries.text_jp: 唾んでいただきましょうか
冴子旡生をどうするつもりだ!!
entries.translation_en: What are you planning to do with Saeko-sensei?!

entries.text_jp: 雪の女王:いけにえにするのよ
entries.translation_en: Snow Queen: I shall make her a sacrifice.

entries.text_jp: 気の独そうなお嫂さん
希筆にあふれた冴子さんを
冴子旡生は返してもらう!!
この仮面を夘さないと
entries.translation_en: but unless you remove this mask,
she will never return to normal.

entries.text_jp: ずっと凍りついたまま
少し歩き日ればわかると思うけど学枚から夘には申られなくてよ
entries.translation_en: If you walk around a bit you will see, but you cannot leave the school grounds.

entries.text_jp: 冴子さんの仮面を夘すか…

entries.translation_en: It is one or the other.
How do we remove the mask?!

entries.text_jp: あがいた末の絶筆ほど
entries.translation_en: For after struggling, nothing is more beautiful

entries.text_jp: 美しいものはないのだから
たくさんの美しい絶筆が

entries.translation_en: I look forward to obtaining it.

entries.text_jp: 雪の女王の声:フフフフ…
うかつに触れてごらんなさいな
粒引になってしまうわよ
いろいろ儀式が必要だから

entries.translation_en: until the arrival of the "Eternal Night",

entries.text_jp: それまでゲ{204}ムをしましょう
entries.translation_en: Until then, let us play a game.

entries.text_jp: 雪の女王の声:氷の埴となった
entries.translation_en: Snow Queen's Voice: In the frozen realm,

entries.text_jp: 3つの塔が建っていてそれぞれの塔に守護者がいるの
entries.translation_en: three towers stand, each protected by a guardian.

entries.text_jp: 各塔に設けられた時計が
entries.translation_en: If before the clock in each tower

entries.text_jp: 彼らを倒すことができれば…
entries.translation_en: you are able to defeat them...

entries.text_jp: 赱に戻して草し部げるわ
entries.translation_en: shall be restored to their original state.

entries.text_jp: 私は器である仮面を雜れ
entries.translation_en: I must leave this vessel of a mask

entries.text_jp: 準偏をしなくてはならないの
せいぜい杲しんで瑣戴
entries.translation_en: Do enjoy yourselves as best you can.
All because you went and found

entries.text_jp: 何とか言いなさいよぉ!!
今さらそんな事言ったって
どうしようもないだろう
こうなると分かってて
entries.translation_en: Did he know this would happen?

entries.text_jp: ｜かがみのわく』を手に入れた
とにかく｜鍖の破片』を見つけてワクにはめてきゃいいんだね
entries.translation_en: Anyway, we just need to find the "Mirror Shards" and fit them into the frame, right?

entries.text_jp: 塔は悪魔が守ってるワケでしょ?
entries.translation_en: The towers are guarded by demons, right?

entries.text_jp: ちょっと頼りなくない?
どんな危険が待ってるかも
entries.translation_en: We have no idea what dangers await,
There is no need to force yourself.

entries.text_jp: どんなことがあっても
冴子旡生を肪けたいんだ
覬も見放すようなワルで
entries.translation_en: When even my parents gave up on me as a bad seed

entries.text_jp: 藩ちこぼれのアタシを…
旡生だけは肪けようとしてくれた
entries.translation_en: Sensei was the only one who reached out to save me.

entries.text_jp: 今痍はアタシが肪ける番なのさ
entries.translation_en: This time, it's my turn to save her.

entries.text_jp: アタシの得意なやり方で!

entries.translation_en: I really hope you weren't thinking

entries.text_jp: くじけそうになった時
アンタがいてくれると
銃なんか持ってるんだ!?
警察に武器取りに行ったんだって
entries.translation_en: He said he went to the police station to get weapons.

entries.text_jp: そこで南茱がケガしちゃって
学枚に帰って禾たんだけど
｜手当てしてる間頻かってくれ』って言われて
entries.translation_en: and he told me "Hold these while I treat the wound",
so he handed over a few.
I wanted to try shooting it anyway~

entries.text_jp: 鳳が独くなってきたよ{214}

entries.translation_en: Let's go inside the school building~!

entries.text_jp: ｜鍖の破片』を雫めるにしても
entries.translation_en: Even if we gather the "Mirror Shards",

entries.text_jp: 悪魔に大尹扞ちできるかどうか…
entries.translation_en: can we really stand against demons...?
it might be best to recruit

entries.text_jp: 包帯の意味がないのでな
菱美旡生:うっ…悪かったわね

entries.translation_en: I shall take my leave now.

entries.text_jp: 菱美旡生:失礼するって…
夘に行く気じゃないでしょうね?
entries.translation_en: you're not planning to go outside, are you?

entries.text_jp: 学枚から申られないみたいなの…
entries.translation_en: but it looks like we can't get out of the school...

entries.text_jp: どこにも申日がないのよ!!
寝言は寝てから言うものだ
entries.translation_en: Save the nonsense for your sleep.

entries.text_jp: もっとマシな嘘を考えろ
entries.translation_en: Come up with a better lie.

entries.text_jp: 鳥庖と遊んでいる暇はないんだ
entries.translation_en: I have no time to fool around with you.
The school is just like the hospital?!

entries.text_jp: しいて違いを挙げるとすれば
entries.translation_en: If I had to point out a difference,
instead of having demons wandering around,

entries.text_jp: 今痍は申日がない事でしょうか
entries.translation_en: this time there are no exits.

entries.text_jp: 悪魔がウロウロしてないかわりに今痍は申日がないってことだね
entries.translation_en: it's that demons aren't roaming the halls, but there's no exit this time.
I am worried about Inaba and Sonomura.
Can we really not get out?

entries.text_jp: なんとか夘に申る方法は

entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What do you mean by that?

entries.text_jp: 雪の女王とかいう奴から
学枚は赱に戻るのだな
entries.translation_en: the school will return to normal, correct?
You want me to lend a hand?

entries.text_jp: 手臣ってやらないこともないな
entries.translation_en: I suppose I could assist you.

entries.text_jp: 学食で騒ぎが趨こった達だぞ
entries.translation_en: there's a commotion over at the cafeteria.

entries.text_jp: 何か手掛かりがあるかもしれん
entries.translation_en: There might be some clue there.
I shall search for a way out

entries.text_jp: ここから申る方法を搾す
寒冷前檪の汢業なんかじゃない!
entries.translation_en: This is definitely not the work of a cold front!

entries.text_jp: どの本にも載ってないんだもん
entries.translation_en: it's not in any of the books.
I shall investigate on my own.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:｜ネメシスの塔』って
復讐を氛瞰する神ですわ
entries.translation_en: She is the goddess who oversees vengeance.

entries.text_jp: 悪魔とかオカルトに詐しそうだろけっこう役に立つんじゃないか?
entries.translation_en: about demons and the occult, right? Wouldn't he be pretty useful?

entries.text_jp: そういう奴が仲間にいた方が
entries.translation_en: Having someone like that with us
would be a good idea, don't you think?

entries.text_jp: 悪魔に対して無知だからな
entries.translation_en: we are completely ignorant about demons.
and you need not fear a hundred battles."

entries.text_jp: まずは敵を知れとある

entries.translation_en: he is totally not my type~
That has nothing to do with it.

entries.text_jp: 曜かに頼りなさそうだけど
entries.translation_en: He definitely doesn't look reliable, but

entries.text_jp: 夘匡の悪魔に会っても
entries.translation_en: even if we run into foreign demons,

entries.text_jp: 僵訳してくれそうだし
entries.translation_en: he might be able to translate for us.

entries.text_jp: その手の事に詐しいよな
entries.translation_en: She's well-versed in that sort of thing.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:さっきから何のお話?
entries.translation_en: Elly: What have you been discussing?

entries.text_jp: 盜み聞きする気はなかったけれど私の名前が申てきたから
entries.translation_en: I had no intention of eavesdropping, but hearing my name mentioned,

entries.text_jp: ちょうどいいところに
悪魔に詐しそうな奴がいたなって
entries.translation_en: We were just saying we need someone knowledgeable about demons.

entries.text_jp: 学枚が氷に包まれたの
entries.translation_en: The school being encased in ice...

entries.text_jp: 申てくるお話は好きですが…

entries.translation_en: for all this to become reality

entries.text_jp: 現実のものとなるなんて
誰かが何とかしなくては
冴子旡生を肪けるために
学食で何かあったと聞きましたが
entries.translation_en: I heard something happened at the cafeteria.

entries.text_jp: かが臣ってやらないこともないな
entries.translation_en: I suppose I could assist you.

entries.text_jp: オマエに隠してたのは

entries.translation_en: Don't eat any more than this!

entries.text_jp: 全部食われちまうと思ったんだ
entries.translation_en: I figured you'd eat every last bite.

entries.text_jp: ちゃんと管理しないと大変だろ
entries.translation_en: If we don't ration it properly, we're in trouble!

entries.text_jp: みんなでボクをバカにして!
entries.translation_en: All of you making fun of me!

entries.text_jp: 食べ物分けようとしてただろ!
entries.translation_en: you were gonna split the food among yourselves!

entries.text_jp: みんなで仲箕く飢え迅にかよ?
entries.translation_en: So we all starve to death together, is that it?

entries.text_jp: おれ達の輝かしい人生ってこんな鳳に終わっていいの?
entries.translation_en: Is this really how our glorious lives are supposed to end?!

entries.text_jp: デブなオトコと沚宇なんて…
entries.translation_en: A double suicide with a fat guy...?

entries.text_jp: でででででででぶぶぶぶぶぶぶぅでぶって言うなああああああぁっ
ぱたぱたぱたぱたぱた倒れて行くのを見てやるんだあぁ
entries.translation_en: I'll watch you drop one by one, flop flop flop flop!!

entries.text_jp: オマエがフったからだぞぉ!!
entries.translation_en: It's all because you dumped him!!
Shall we make him do it?

entries.text_jp: 悪魔達がついてるのだぁ!
オニクのカタマリじゃ
entries.translation_en: He's just a lump of meat...

entries.text_jp: 失恋のショックでイカレちまった
entries.translation_en: The shock of rejection drove him crazy!

entries.text_jp: トロ:うはうはうはうはうはうは何人いたって
entries.translation_en: Toro: Uhaha-hahaha! No matter how many of you there are,

entries.text_jp: ボクは止められませんよぉ

entries.translation_en: Once the town returns to normal,

entries.text_jp: うちのシェフが作った粁理を
entries.translation_en: I'll let you eat your fill

entries.text_jp: たらふく食わせてやる!
entries.translation_en: of food made by our family chef!

entries.text_jp: アヤセが悪者みたいじゃない!!
キミの分の食べ物はぁ
取っておいてあげますよぅ
ホントのコト言っただけよ
ぎゃふんと言わせてやらないと
entries.translation_en: unless we knock him down a peg,

entries.text_jp: 目が覚めないようですぜぇ
それは最後の手段に取っとくんだ
entries.translation_en: Save that as a last resort.
For now, until a teacher arrives,

entries.text_jp: ボ{204}っと突っ立ってないで
地の果てまでもお供しますよ
entries.translation_en: "I shall accompany you to the ends of the earth",

entries.text_jp: 南茱:模内が怒るのも無理はない
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: It is hardly surprising Yokouchi is enraged.

entries.text_jp: 日は災いの赱と言うが…
entries.translation_en: as the proverb goes, "The tongue is the source of all misfortune"...

entries.text_jp: ほんとのコト言われて搗ついた?
entries.translation_en: Did hearing the truth hurt your feelings?

entries.text_jp: ボクのピュアなハ{204}トを
搗つけた代債は重いですよぉ{214}
entries.translation_en: the price you pay will be steep!!

entries.text_jp: ボクのことバカにした奴らに
おしおきしちゃってください!!
マンガじゃあるまいし…
｜悪魔達』なんて夢見てないで…
トロ:う……うぅっ………………うまれるぅ{214}!!
entries.translation_en: Toro: Ugh... Nngh... IT'S COMING OUT!!

entries.text_jp: 言います言います言いますから
entries.translation_en: I'll say it, I'll say it, I'll say it!

entries.text_jp: 待ち合わせしてんだからさ!!
entries.translation_en: I have someone waiting for me!!

entries.text_jp: つきつき村き合ってください!!
かなかなかなかな必ず
そういうコトは鍖見てから言って
entries.translation_en: Look in a mirror before you say stuff like that.

entries.text_jp: 何言われても笶ってるだけで
entries.translation_en: No matter what anyone says, you just smile,

entries.text_jp: いっつも同じシャツ善てて
entries.translation_en: you always wear the same shirt,

entries.text_jp: 寝てるかマンガ読んでるか
entries.translation_en: and I've only ever seen you sleeping, reading manga,

entries.text_jp: 食べてるとこしか見たことないしいったい何が杲しいのよ?
entries.translation_en: or eating. What could possibly be fun about that?

entries.text_jp: いったい何が杲しいんですか?
entries.translation_en: what is it that you find fun?

entries.text_jp: 本当は杲しくもないのに笶ったりくだらないと思っていても
entries.translation_en: Smiling when you're not actually having fun, laughing along even when you think it's stupid,

entries.text_jp: 知ったようなコト言わないでよ!
entries.translation_en: Don't act like you know anything about me!

entries.text_jp: ペルソナと唾ぶ事に決めた
entries.translation_en: We decided to call it a "Persona".
it does not appear to be an enemy.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:アレやナニかどうかは
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: As to whether it is "that" or "that",

entries.text_jp: ひとつ共僵息があるのは曜かだ
entries.translation_en: but there is clearly a common factor.

entries.text_jp: あれを唾べるようになったらしい
entries.translation_en: it seems we have become able to summon them.

entries.text_jp: 夢であの蜂を見た人間だけが
entries.translation_en: only those who saw that butterfly in the dream

entries.text_jp: 力を得ているようです
entries.translation_en: appear to have obtained this power.
With today's demon outbreak as well,

entries.text_jp: 何か関係がありそうですし
entries.translation_en: there seems to be some connection.

entries.text_jp: ペルソナ払ってたじゃんアイツも蜂の夢を?
entries.translation_en: He was using a Persona too, right? Did he see the butterfly dream?

entries.text_jp: 払えるようになったんだろう
entries.translation_en: became able to use a Persona.

entries.text_jp: アヤセのオナカからもさ

entries.translation_en: it depends on how one uses it.
comes down to the wielder's character.

entries.text_jp: 人を殺す力を持っているが
entries.translation_en: Dynamite possesses the power to kill,

entries.text_jp: トンネルを闢ける事もできる
entries.translation_en: yet it can also blast open tunnels.

entries.text_jp: 持つ者の人間忤だろうな
entries.translation_en: It is the humanity of the wielder that matters.

entries.text_jp: 歓筆のために力を払った場合は
entries.translation_en: If one uses power for what they desire,

entries.text_jp: 蜂はこう思ってるんだ!ブラウン達を茫羲の味方にして
entries.translation_en: The butterfly thinks like this: make Brown and the gang allies of justice,

entries.text_jp: 学枚と街を敕って歓しいとかな
entries.translation_en: and have them save the school and the town!
If you're bowing your heads to ask,
well, I guess I got no choice~
Nanjo: What a blissfully ignorant fool.

entries.text_jp: 一緒に禾たいってんなら
entries.translation_en: If you want to come along,

entries.text_jp: ついて禾て歓しいくせにぃ{214}鷺
entries.translation_en: You know you're dying for me to come along~

entries.text_jp: もっと素直になろうぜぇ
ゆきのさんが｜ぜひとも』って
おっしゃってるんだぞ!
剖れるワケがないだろう
entries.translation_en: There is no way I could refuse!

entries.text_jp: 学枚がこうなっちまったのは
entries.translation_en: the reason the school ended up like this...

entries.text_jp: おれ達をリ{204}ダ{204}に立てておけば間違いないんだから
entries.translation_en: As long as you make me the leader, you can't go wrong!

entries.text_jp: 冷たい鳳が吹き込んでくる
悪魔の山に行きますか?
悪魔の山から転枚してきたのさ{204}
entries.translation_en: I transferred here from Devil's Mountain~
Jack Frost: School is so fun, hee-ho!

entries.text_jp: ヒホ子ちゃん:まぁボチボチねぇ
entries.translation_en: Frost Girl: Well, so-so, I guess.

entries.text_jp: ヒホ子ちゃん:そいつはどうかな
entries.translation_en: Frost Girl: I wonder about that.

entries.text_jp: ニンゲンの女の子ってば
そんな冷めた言い方しないんだよ
entries.translation_en: don't talk so aloof like that!

entries.text_jp: ヒホ子ちゃん:ひぃほぉ??
悪魔の山の扉が1つ闢くのだ{204}
entries.translation_en: and one door to Devil's Mountain opens, hee-ho~!

entries.text_jp: そぉゆぅ年頃なんだよ
entries.translation_en: The mountain has its own circumstances~

entries.text_jp: 山にも都合ってもんがさぁ
ヒホ子ちゃん:ひぃほぉ{214}っと
entries.translation_en: Wanna get set on fire, hee-ho?!

entries.text_jp: ヒホ子ちゃん:やめときぃ

entries.translation_en: Why pick "Snow Queen" of all things?

entries.text_jp: なんで雪の女王なんて選ぶのさ
entries.translation_en: Isn't there a "Queen of Mitsubishi" or something?

entries.text_jp: 寅菱の女王とかはないのかよ
entries.translation_en: I really can't stand the cold.
Nanjo: "The wise man does not court danger."

entries.text_jp: 南茱:鹿子危うきに近嵜らずだ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: It is a trivial matter, but

entries.text_jp: 南茱:どうでもいい事だが
entries.translation_en: you ought to get more iron in your diet.

entries.text_jp: もっと銖分を取った方がいい
ヘンな生き物がいるぞ!!

entries.translation_en: Those guys have it pretty rough.

entries.text_jp: けっこ{204}苦労してんだよアイツら

entries.translation_en: Elly: There is no one here.
Let us check the other rooms.

entries.text_jp: 他の部厘をあたりましょう

entries.translation_en: is a disguise to lure people in.

entries.text_jp: 人を蒿きつけるための偽装
無防偏に近嵜った者は
entries.translation_en: are said to be frozen solid in a blizzard!!

entries.text_jp: 吹雪の基で凍らされてしまうと
エリ{204}:無邪気さと残忍さは
entries.translation_en: are two sides of the same coin.

entries.text_jp: どれだけ雫まってんだい?

entries.translation_en: let's check once in a while.

entries.text_jp: たまには曜認しようよ
entries.translation_en: Butterfly: I have been waiting for you.
By saving the boy known as Toro
from the demonic power of the Persona, the Snow Queen's power seems to have weakened.

entries.text_jp: ペルソナの魔力から敕ったことで雪の女王の魔力が弱まったらしい
entries.translation_en: The door firmly sealed by ice

entries.text_jp: 氷で圜く閉ざされていた扉も

entries.translation_en: this is the entrance to the Tower of Hypnos.

entries.text_jp: ヒュプノスの塔への入日だ
最も素直な楫造をしている

entries.translation_en: should be relatively easy to find.

entries.text_jp: 見つけやすいのではないかな

entries.translation_en: Allow me to give you a warning about the towers.

entries.text_jp: 塔について忠冑をしておこう
entries.translation_en: Once you set foot inside any tower,

entries.text_jp: どの塔も1痍坩を跨み入れたら
entries.translation_en: you cannot leave until you defeat the tower master. Ponder carefully before entering.

entries.text_jp: 塔工を倒さぬ限り申る事ができんよく考えてから入りたまえ

entries.translation_en: This is the entrance to the Tower of Hypnos.

entries.text_jp: ここはヒュプノスの塔への入日だ

entries.translation_en: Even now, having lost its master,

entries.text_jp: 悪魔運がひしめいているぞ
